description: 固定两版恢复门控，比较独立计算和共享 DURA/direct 的八类输出及相同 CPU 线程用时。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

notes: Frozen DURA/direct, two fixed final20 gates and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL for source-only evaluation; no TX/V/target reads or model updates.
Independent path recomputes DURA/direct for each gate; shared path computes common inputs once. Byte compare all eight fields for each gate.
672 source records, two reversed-order paired passes; both CPU 2 threads. Timing excludes load, comparison and I/O; no parallel throughput or target parity claim.
Seven focused tests and independent P0/P1 review passed; real source frozen-checkpoint smoke first.
